entities.summary: Ruben Caballero Labajo is a Filipino Catholic prelate who previously served as the Auxiliary Bishop of the Archdiocese of Cebu from 2022 to 2025. He is currently—and the first bishop of–the newly erected Diocese of Prosperidad.
